title: reduce gpu memory and workspace usage via arena tuning + activation checkpointing + scratch buffer reductions
author: Asha Khatri
release_notes: Reduced peak GPU memory for common LLM rigs by ~18-25% via arena sizing, scratch buffer coalescing and optional finer-grained activation checkpointing. No API changes.
description: Context: production inference workloads are hitting peak GPU workspace allocations with 8k+ context sizes and mixed batch sizes. Motivation: reduce OOMs and peak SLO violations without forcing quantization or model changes. This PR introduces a multi-pronged runtime optimization: 1) dynamic arena tuning: we replace the static per-device arena heuristics with a two-pass startup sampler that derives percentiles of allocation sizes and sets per-device arena bucket sizes and growth factors to reduce fragmentation and over-allocation; 2) scratch buffer coalescing: the scratch buffer manager now coalesces short-lived per-layer temporaries into a shared per-request scratch region when safe, and reuses buffers across attention/ffn stages to avoid peak spikes; 3) activation checkpointing granularity: add an optional mid-layer checkpointing mode that checkpoints only heavy FFN blocks while keeping attention activations in memory to avoid latency regressions; and 4) KV cache compaction hooks: added an asynchronous compaction path to reclaim slack in KV allocations when sequence lengths shrink between requests. Implementation notes: changes live in runtime/cuda_arena.cc, runtime/scratch_buffer_manager.{h,cc}, runtime/activation_checkpointing.cc, and runtime/kv_cache.cc. The arena sampler runs at agent startup (cold-start only) and emits metrics (arena.bucket_sizes, arena.frac_reclaimed) to help tuning. Safety: checkpointing mode is off by default and controlled by config runtime.checkpoint_mode with values {off, ffn-only, full}. Backwards compatibility: no public API changes, default behavior unchanged. Tests & verification: unit tests for arena sizing and scratch reuse, integration test on perf-canary cluster, and canary rollout across 3 production hosts. Results: on internal Llama-70B-like config with 8192 context and mixed batch sizes we measured 18-25% reduction in peak GPU memory and a 6% median latency increase in the ffn-only checkpoint mode; full checkpointing yields ~35% memory reduction but ~22% latency regression (disabled by default). KV compaction recovers ~5% of slack memory on workloads with variable context lengths. CI: build + unit tests + integration passed after one flake in perf-canary which was re-run. Rollout: Canary -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback threshold on OOMs. Related: ENG-842, ENG-856.
commits:
Commit 1: runtime: add arena startup sampler and new bucket sizing logic (cuda_arena.cc/h)
Commit 2: runtime: implement scratch buffer coalescing and per-request shared scratch region (scratch_buffer_manager.h/cc)
Commit 3: runtime: add mid-layer activation checkpointing and config flags (activation_checkpointing.cc/h)
Commit 4: runtime: add async KV cache compaction hook and metrics (kv_cache.cc)
Commit 5: tests: unit + integration + perf-canary config and dashboards

diff_snippets: runtime/cuda_arena.cc: replaced static bucket array with dynamic sampling flow; old: static_size[] -> new: sample and set bucket sizes at startup;
runtime/scratch_buffer_manager.cc: added SharedScratchRegion class and reuse semantics; example change: allocateScratch(size_t s) -> tryCoalesceOrAlloc(s);
runtime/activation_checkpointing.cc: added checkpoint_mode enum {OFF, FFN_ONLY, FULL} and logic to checkpoint only FFN blocks when runtime.checkpoint_mode == FFN_ONLY;
runtime/kv_cache.cc: added asyncCompaction() run on background executor to shrink allocations when slack > 20% and sequence lengths vary;
review_comments: Luis Ortega: Can you add a feature flag for the arena sampler? We don't want startup sampling to interact with node autoscaling during rapid deploys.
Maya Chen: The scratch coalescing path looks good but please add a stress test for interleaved attention+ffn patterns to ensure no cross-request leakage.
Sahil Patel: Please include a flamegraph showing where latency regressions come from for ffn-only checkpointing; also add metric coverage for checkpointed compute vs memory savings.
author_replies: Asha Khatri: Added runtime.feature_flags.arena_sampler and made sampling opt-in via env RUNTIME_ARENA_SAMPLE=true. Sampling will skip if node is under autoscale pressure (added detectors).
Asha Khatri: Added stress test tests/runtime/test_scratch_reuse.cpp that simulates interleaved attention and ffn patterns and validated with ASAN in CI.
Asha Khatri: Uploaded perf artifacts and flamegraphs to the PR thread; added metrics runtime.checkpointed_flops and runtime.memory_saved_bytes to perf dashboards.
